def control(obs):
 global filtered
 h=obs['hitch_deg']
 cam=obs.get('views',{}).get('camera')
 if not cam:
  return (2.5*h,0,-23)
 theta=math.radians(-h)
 rear=obs['rig']['trailer_rear']
 origin=cam['origin']
 sides=[[],[]]
 for b,d in cam.get('walls',[]):
  b=math.radians(b)
  dx=origin[0]+d*math.cos(b)-rear[0]
  dy=origin[1]+d*math.sin(b)-rear[1]
  s=-dx*math.cos(theta)-dy*math.sin(theta)
  l=-dx*math.sin(theta)+dy*math.cos(theta)
  if s>0.3:
   sides[0 if l<0 else 1].append((s,l))
 desired=filtered
 for look in [4.0,3.0,2.0]:
  vals=[]
  for side in sides:
   pts=sorted(side,key=lambda p:abs(p[0]-look))[:5]
   pts=[p for p in pts if abs(p[0]-look)<1.8]
   if not pts: break
   weights=[1/(0.2+(p[0]-look)**2) for p in pts]
   sw=sum(weights)
   ms=sum(w*p[0] for w,p in zip(weights,pts))/sw
   ml=sum(w*p[1] for w,p in zip(weights,pts))/sw
   den=sum(w*(p[0]-ms)**2 for w,p in zip(weights,pts))
   slope=sum(w*(p[0]-ms)*(p[1]-ml) for w,p in zip(weights,pts))/max(den,0.01)
   vals.append(ml+slope*(look-ms))
  if len(vals)==2:
   lateral=sum(vals)/2
   desired=max(-29,min(29,math.degrees(math.atan2(5.2*lateral,look*look))))
   break
 filtered+=0.18*(desired-filtered)
 steer=max(-34,min(34,0.75*h+1.8*(h-filtered)))
 return (steer,-0.7,-23)
